content: Letter 18, to Amīrzāda Bāysunghur in Herat (825/1422?, Herat): Ibn Turka complains that he has attended Bāysunghur's court two days without being allowed to see the prince, and suggests it would be easier if Bāysunghur graced a majlis with his presence, where they could talk (TMN/M f. 139a, TMN/MS pp. 13-14, TMN/D pp. 175-76).
